proposed_facts.reason: Initialization clears six slots; selected-credit actions replace them. The unpaused post-increment >= threshold and null-tally guard control removal and tally creation, not exact-frame equality.

Eligibility, localization exceptions and language-indexed geometry match the source. The cue table contains 2350 followed by 2000; a single check outside the pause guard consumes at most one cue without an explicit terminator branch.

Initialization and numeric-state transitions agree. B pause entry does not require selection; B over a selection does not resume state 1. Start and tally handling preserve the documented step behavior.

Stick values directly replace cursor coordinates after dead-zone and nonlinear scaling; Y is clamped before projection scaling. Trigger priority is A/B/Start/Z, and the tally counts qualifying records across 198 entries.

Nested selection/action guards, cooldown-gated hit registration, timeline increment, threshold/equality distinctions, particle updates, pause transitions and final cue check match the stated ordering.

Entry animation advancement is guarded while text maintenance and sorting continue. Tally replacement targets the six detail slots, and the exit callback is empty. The description appropriately avoids claiming external teardown ownership.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all eight compiled-layout/pool claims: declarations, address comments, palette values and arithmetic do not establish section extents, ordering, encoding or literal-pool attribution. The volatile const s32 also prevents treating source constants as uniformly floating-point evidence.
Accept both SIS-content deferrals: numeric page records and predicates do not independently establish personnel attribution, exact role text or question-mark content.

Accept the six supersessions: tally creation uses a crossed threshold and removes detail texts rather than all scrolling texts; pause is not a simple B toggle; stick mapping is direct with explicit trigger priority; cues follow nonmonotonic authored order one at a time. These corrections reconcile the proposal with the functionality document.
